answer: The delta holds work receipts rather than names, so the cipher of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. By the gale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
